svg.title: One complete layer, three designs
svg.desc: One complete layer, three designs; 50 MHz · 10 fixed inputs · MobileNet VWW op8 · common optimized software; Mean complete-layer time (ms) — lower is faster; 0; 10; 20; 30; 40; 50; A; 2 reads · DOT4 + ADD; 43.1202; B; 2 reads · fused accumulation; 38.6966; C; 3 reads · fused accumulation; 37.2220; B vs A: 10.259% fewer cycles · 1.1143× speedup; C removes a further 73,728 operand-collection cycles per input.; A already has four-lane INT8 DOT4 hardware. All variants use 32 KiB data RAM.; Includes CPU input/output copies and postprocessing; one resident layer, not full-network or board latency.
